name: Script-sandwich captions
description: A lockup around each phrase's key word: the key word huge in a formal champagne script, written on as it is said, the words before it in small spaced capitals above, the words after below, with fine rules either side. Give a transcript with --words.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* to make it the key word
text.default: Welcome to the *new* way to caption.

accents.label: Key words
accents.description: words to treat as key words wherever they are said, comma separated

palette.label: Colours
palette.description: original: the look's own colours · brand: the brand's accents in their place

parts.words: the caption words and everything drawn with them
